sections.title: You're looking at a Pagesmith starter
sections.body: This whole page is built from editable blocks. Sign in as an editor (see the README) and an Edit toolbar appears — click any text to change it, or use the “+ Add section” button to drop in new parts. When you're happy, hit Save, then Publish.

sections.label: yours to edit
sections.caption: Every word, colour, and block on this page can be changed from the browser — no code required.
